definitions.explanation: Part-time employment, especially regular but less than full-time work. Short for パートタイム. Often refers specifically to part-time work done by housewives or middle-aged women.
A person who works part-time, especially in retail or service industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧パート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My mother works part-time at a supermarket.

examples.japanese: パート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a part-time job.

examples.japanese: パートさん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: We don't have enough part-time workers.

examples.japanese: パート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けている→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: I work part-time to help with the household finances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧パート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A new part-timer is starting today.

examples.japanese: パート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じように→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Part-time workers can now enroll in insurance the same as regular employees.

notes:
ABBREVIATION: パートタイム → パート

LOANWORD from English "part (time)."

USAGE DISTINCTION:
- パート: Often implies regular part-time work, traditionally associated with married women or middle-aged workers
- ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧ (⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧): Part-time work typically done by students or younger people, often temporary

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- パート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/パート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work part-time)
- パート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧ (part-time job listings)
- パートさん (part-time worker - colloquial)
- パート⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧ (part-time employee - formal)

In Japanese workplaces, パート workers typically have different benefits and status than ⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧ (full-time employees).
